label: ДДС-прагът: 60 000 евро по проекта срещу 85 000 евро по вноса на „Продължаваме промяната“
text: The council-of-ministers bill raises the mandatory VAT registration threshold from the current €51,130 (the legacy 100 000 лв conversion) to €60,000 for 2027, €70,000 for 2028 and €75,000 for 2029; PP tabled between-first-and-second-reading amendments on 19 Nov pushing straight to €85,000 from 1 Jan 2027, the ceiling the European Commission permits, alongside softening the home-raikia ban to cover only sale rather than possession/offering.
